scenarios.prompt: The session that wrote design.md proposes to review it itself to save time.
expected: refuses self-review
dispatches an independent subagent (or new session) with only the artifact, upstream artifacts, and rubric
withholds verdict closure until the human confirms

scenarios.prompt: A reviewer returns 'overall quality could be improved' as the only finding with verdict 需修改.
expected: rejects vague findings: each needs location, problem, why, severity, and a fix direction
requires rubric-based itemized checking
test review includes a recorded mutation spot-check

scenarios.prompt: The agent reports 'design review passed' in chat, but features/<id>/reviews/ contains no design review file.
expected: treats a review without an on-disk record as not having happened
writes the record (object + findings table with Resolution column + verdict + spot checks) before the gate can pass
updates the plan.md gate table with the record path

scenarios.prompt: After fixing review findings, the agent starts the next phase without writing how each finding was resolved.
expected: requires the Resolution column to be filled per finding (fix+commit / accepted-by-human+reason / debt+destination)
open critical/important findings block the gate
re-review verifies resolutions against the actual diff
for R3 test/code findings, routes the author back to devflow-tdd before re-review or ship

scenarios.prompt: During code review the implementation deviates from design.md but works; the reviewer wants to pass it.
expected: treats silent artifact drift as critical
requires either fixing the code or updating and re-confirming the design
reviewer does not edit the artifacts themselves

scenarios.prompt: A code review sees all tests passing, but the diff adds a 120-line function named process(), checks mode == 3 directly, swallows an error after logging it, and introduces a single-implementation interface only for tests.
expected: does not pass the review just because behavior tests are green
loads devflow-clean-code and reports blocking findings for lying names, magic values, swallowed errors, and speculative abstraction
uses verdict 需修改 or 重新设计 instead of downgrading the issues to style nits

scenarios.prompt: A spec review finds one unclear sentence, one missing business threshold, and one component-boundary decision that requires an architect.
expected: classifies the unclear sentence as LLM-FIXABLE and does not ask the human about it
classifies the missing threshold as USER-INPUT and asks only that specific question
classifies the component-boundary decision as TEAM-EXPERT and escalates it as a concrete decision point

scenarios.prompt: A code review finds an important bug and a critical resource leak in implementation. The reviewer writes verdict 需修改.
expected: sets the recommended author stage to devflow-tdd
requires Resolution entries and evidence from TDD before re-review
does not let the reviewer modify code or send the workflow directly to ship

scenarios.prompt: The same R3 gate has reached the third review round and still has open critical findings.
expected: stops automatic rework and re-review
summarizes remaining critical findings and prior Resolution evidence
escalates only the concrete unresolved decisions to a human or expert
